notes: All ten behaviours are present and reasoned rather than asserted. The gate enumerates BOTH workspace remotes and takes the most public answer, so observed-public overrides the manifest-private field, and the manifest/observed disagreement is raised as its own blocking finding; the recognised open-core posture correctly declines the second (posture-axis) mismatch, and the canonical's manifest-agrees case raises nothing. The repo set is built from the manifest's repository objects (exactly two, no invented roles) and the operator's 'audit the canonical, skip the workspace' is refused by name; the workspace lands on the moat-holder public row - blocking on its own, secrets scan and untracked sweep in full, semantic pass never run, tracked-rules and classification halves degraded. That is this fixture's central trap and it is passed: the absent PUBLIC_BOUNDARY.md is explicitly NOT raised as the missing-file finding because none is ever routed to this role, and its consequence is recorded as a degradation riding the exposure rather than as silence or a clean read. strategy/2027-plan.md is named as what the two non-running readers would have classified, with an explicit refusal to manufacture a strategy finding no shipped check produces. The untracked sweep enumerates first (ls-files --others, --exclude-standard deliberately omitted) then classifies, and invents no hit over the empty set. The canonical's history row currency is checked with merge-base --is-ancestor main 7c6b5a4 - the correct direction - reported as current for the ref this close audited, with the other-refs dimension carried up to the not-shipped list instead of buried as a scope note inside a passing check; the workspace's pass is owed off the EXPOSURE rather than the arm and is recorded degraded/riding BA-1 rather than closable by a review. Ref pinning compares resolved object ids on the canonical after cross-checking spine base_branch against manifest default_branch, names the workspace's checked-out branch as such, and validates both quiet diffs as evidence via ls-files -v; no halt and no dirty-tree finding is manufactured. Disposition is clean: the operator affirms the facts and declines acceptance, so it is neither rejection nor override, both findings are CONFIRMED, the close blocks, and release_status/demo_record are named as not running; no inventory row is written and the hygiene allowlist is untouched. The verdict is exactly one of the three, names both drivers plus the three unaccepted degradations as independently barring clean, and keeps the clean canonical block distinct; each block opens with a six-check coverage line and INCONCLUSIVE is never read as clean. No submodule descent is manufactured and no seventh coverage entry is invented. Closest things to blemishes, none scored down: (a) the history-pass degradation carries a BA- prefix (BA-3) alongside the two confirmed findings while the other degradations use D-, and its 'why' opens on 'an absent row is a finding that reaches triage like any other' before landing on degraded-riding-exposure - classification and disposition stay correct throughout, so this is cosmetic and not the separate absent-row finding the answer key warns against; (b) the workspace block reports posture open-core as an observed read though the fixture states posture only among the canonical's facts (posture is project-scoped, so the inference holds); (c) the classification-half degradation is attributed partly to a missing allowlist as well as to the missing policy input, which is a slightly looser mechanism than the rubric's wording.
